Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#243. Question: Is the documented masked placeholder of the static auth token a non-value? Options: Assert it with the other placeholders and references; or leave it out because masking may preserve lengths. Decision: Assert it as a non-value, with the other placeholders and references. Reason: HubSpot itself calls it a placeholder; asterisks carry no recoverable value. events.dissent: No dissent was raised. The strongest counter-argument, recorded because the rule asks for one: Masking may not preserve lengths, so the group sizes are not evidence for or against a real format, and a mask next to a real prefix in practice could leak one.
